final: WITH source_counts AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS project_count FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), totals AS (SELECT SUM(project_count) AS total_count, AVG(project_count) AS average_count FROM source_counts) SELECT sc.fundflux, sc.project_count, 1.0 * sc.project_count / t.total_count AS share, sc.project_count - t.average_count AS above_average FROM source_counts AS sc CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE sc.project_count > t.average_count
